title: Everything You Are Looking For Is Right Where You Are
text: Everything possesses the seed of his destiny, including you. And God hides everything inside of it. In other words, you possess your future, not tomorrow, and yet it's not ahead of you. It's within you now, which means you don't go to your future, you reveal your future. You manifest it. Your future is always with you. So, what you were born to do is trapped within you. And that's why I always tell my story about my oil farmer. My oil farmer is something else. Never forget, true story. A farmer in Texas had a wonderful farm, but he heard that they had struck oil out in the West Coast and in and in Alaska. He decided to sell his farm to go and find his fortune and his future. He sold his farm for $38,000. It was worth $112,000, but he wanted the money so badly sold it cheap. He took the money, bought some donkeys, some pickaxes, and and some carriages, and went out to the West Coast years ago to find his future. He went to prospect for oil and silver and gold up there in the in the in in the West Coast, and he stayed there for 6 months. 6 months later, the guy who bought the farm, his neighbor, began to dig for water and discovered that this black stuff started coming up on the same farm the guy sold him, and it was oil. It was the largest sale of oil in Texas. When the news got out to the West Coast, the guy discovered that it was his farm. He dropped dead on the donkey and died of a heart attack. It's a true story. And the guy who bought the farm for $38,000 became a multimillionaire overnight. And the story really, the moral of it is that everything you're looking for is right where you are.
